title: 옷 가게에서 입어 보고 바꾸기
objective: Learners can use 10 key clothing-store words (탈의실, 입어 보다, 사이즈, 크다/작다, 딱 맞다, 다른 색, 한 치수 큰 거/작은 거, 교환, 환불, 영수증) in short sentences. They will use them to ask to try clothes on, ask for another size or color, and ask to exchange an item or get a refund.
summary: Ten key words for a clothing store in Korea: trying clothes on, talking about size and fit, asking for another size or color, and asking to exchange an item or get a refund with a receipt.

task.title: FILL IN THE BLANKS
task.line: Read the situation in brackets, then fill each blank with a word from the list. Change the word's form if needed, and when there are two blanks, write the answers in order.

words.exampleMeaning: What size do you wear? (a clerk asking politely)

words.meaning: to be big / to be small (on the wearer)
words.example: 바지는 좀 크고, 셔츠는 좀 작아요.
words.exampleMeaning: The pants are a bit big, and the shirt is a bit small.
Do you also have this in another color?

words.korean: 한 치수 큰 거 / 작은 거
words.roman: han chisu keun geo / jageun geo
words.meaning: one size up / one size down
words.example: 좀 작아요. 한 치수 큰 거 있어요?
words.exampleMeaning: It's a bit small. Do you have one a size up?

words.meaning: exchange (swapping an item for another one)

words.exampleMeaning: I'd like a refund for this, please.
Please be sure to bring the receipt when you exchange it.

exercises: Fill in the two blanks (you are holding a shirt and want to try it on): 이거 ____ 봐도 돼요? — 네, ____은 저쪽에 있어요.
Fill in the blank (the clerk asks what size you wear): 손님, ____가 어떻게 되세요?
Fill in the two blanks (the pants are too big, so you want a smaller pair): 바지가 너무 ____. 한 치수 ____ 거 있어요?
Fill in the two blanks (the size is perfect, but you don't like the color): 사이즈는 ____ 맞아요. 그런데 다른 ____도 있어요?
Fill in the blank (you want to swap the item for a different size): 이거 다른 사이즈로 ____하고 싶어요.
Fill in the two blanks (you hand over the paper you got when you paid, because you want your money back): ____ 여기 있어요. 이거 ____돼요?
